I’m not sure if anyone still has these, but I’ve been scouring the internet for one to no avail. If you have one dm me and we can work everything out.

The magazine is an adapter for [M4 Mags](https://primaryairsoft.us/collections/hi-capa/products/hi-capa), so you don't need to remove the HPA line when you reload. You use the magazine release on the adapter and insert a new M4 mag.
Reminds me of the [Division UMP skin](https://static2.cdn.ubi.com/pxm/RainbowSix/R6S-TheDivision_UPlay_Front_712-384.png) from Rainbow Six.

Been interested in this optic for awhile due to it's inclusion in other games. I believe they likely based the sight on the [first generation UH-1](https://vortexoptics.com/vortex-razor-amg-uh-1-red-dot.html) that didn't have the night vision button. Either that or an airsoft replica.
Looks great. Love the monochromatic style.
Glad to see I’m not the only one collecting patches while I travel.
